blocks.p: During {page:events|Wayfarer's Reverie} (August 25 to September 1), a Festival Coordinator on each continent gives a quest to visit eight famous places. Bring the four proofs to Fylinn, Sworn to Winds for a Legionnaire Summoning Crystal (or an Everlasting Legionnaire Tonic, a Miniature Legionnaire, a Legion Loot Bag, or once per account a Reverie Gift).

Only one character or hero in the party has to reach each place, and the runner doesn't need the quest, so these are runs, not fights. Each map below shows the area to reach, the outpost to start from, and the areas between them.
Take all four quests first, so every place counts on the way:

ul: {quest:101380} from Festival Coordinator Teron in {area:55}. Reward: Proof of Flames.
{quest:100779} from Festival Coordinator Tsuru in {area:194}. Reward: Proof of Waves.
{quest:101072} from Festival Coordinator Khuri in {area:449}. Reward: Proof of Winds.
{quest:100457} from Festival Enthusiast Styr Wolf-Handed in {area:642}. Reward: Proof of Mountains.

Visit the Shiverpeak bloodstone (Far North): from {area:638} through {area:558} into {area:612}. Take {quest:100351} from Saerin in {area:638} and enter the dungeon through its portal (not the Inscription Stone). The door at the end of the first level needs the dungeon key the Paranoia Ettin drops, so this one can't simply be run. The bloodstone is at the end of the dungeon's third level (sorry, we don't have the dungeon's maps yet).
